mapper.select: SELECT id, state, cursor_event_id AS cursorEventId, range_from_ms AS rangeFromMs, processed, started_at AS startedAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, last_error AS lastError FROM analytics_backfill_state WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, state, cursor_event_id AS cursorEventId, range_from_ms AS rangeFromMs, processed, started_at AS startedAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, last_error AS lastError FROM analytics_backfill_state WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE analytics_backfill_state SET state = 'RUNNING', cursor_event_id = #{cursor}, range_from_ms = #{rangeFromMs}, processed = 0, started_at = NOW(3), last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state <> 'RUNNING'

UPDATE analytics_backfill_state SET state = 'RUNNING', cursor_event_id = 0, range_from_ms = #{rangeFromMs}, processed = 0, started_at = NOW(3), last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state <> 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT e.event_id AS taskId, e.order_id AS orderId, e.event_type AS eventType, e.occurred_at AS occurredAt, o.application_id AS applicationId, o.user_id AS userId FROM purchase_order_event e JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id = e.order_id WHERE e.event_id > #{cursor} AND e.occurred_at >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{rangeFromSeconds}) ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT #{limit}
